messages:
lee: Quick follow-up idea: 'precision-smoothing proxy' to avoid hard cliffs when switching fp8/int8/4bit. Blend logits from a tiny high-precision sketch with the low-precision lane for N tokens.

maya: Sounds promising. Do we run both models always? cost concern.

lee: No, only run sketch when a cheap deg-signal triggers. Sketch is small (1-2 blocks) or a distilled head. alpha decays over tokens.

ravi: Suggest alpha = clamp((degscore - T)/(1-T),0,1) then exp decay. Also need EWMA on degscore to avoid flips.

pat: Ops: sketch implies extra infra. Put sketch on a separate pool `smoothing-sketch` and enforce budget_per_min.

lee: Profile fields: smoothing.enabled, sketch_model, threshold, hysteresis_tokens, budget_per_min, canary_pct. Example snippet in PR.

ops-bot: Reminder: file infra ticket for new pool and quota if sketch enabled.

maya: Eval plan: shadow compare blended vs hard-switch on failure prompts: measure degscore reduction, p95 latency, cost delta, hallucination checks.

lee: I'll open PR with schema, tiny runtime adapter sketch, and the canary plan. Tagging you all for review.
